purpose: Add executable routing, packet-completeness, decision thresholds/defaults, authority split, enforcement states, budget routing, outcome-based reviewer scoring, protected process control and zero-delta health.

opening_milestones.meaning: Candidate deltas exist; no five-file successor implied.
At least one coherent admitted delta set has been composed into all five successor files.
All mechanically enumerated Tier-A SectionUnits for the bound DesignEpoch are qualified or fully resolved.
Tier A/B/C closure is complete for the bound DesignEpoch.

step0_routing.rule: Every work item is assigned exactly one primary route before substantive review. Route escalation is allowed; silent downgrade is forbidden.
step0_routing.escalation_rule: Any semantic-touch signal discovered on NON_SEMANTIC_REPAIR escalates to the appropriate semantic route before merge.

modes.BYTE_IDENTICAL: All reviewers receive byte-identical packet payloads; useful for strict blind comparison but does not by itself prove closure completeness.
modes.SEMANTICALLY_EQUIVALENT: Reviewer renderings may differ only through a declared deterministic transformation with transformation proof and same bound source/closure.
modes.COHERENT_COMPLETE: Every mechanically derived reference/dependency closure member is included or explicitly excluded with typed reason and exclusion proof.

rules: Missing required closure members under COHERENT_COMPLETE is PACKET_INCOMPLETE, not reviewer failure.
Reviewer-proposed closure expansion creates a NEW_CLOSURE_CANDIDATE until mechanically validated; it does not retroactively make the packet incomplete.
Blind reviewers must receive the same completeness proof and exact source/DesignEpoch binding.

close_finding.rule: Closure evidence must meet the action threshold and be at least the original finding's verified evidence class for the dispositive claim; lower-class counterargument may narrow but not close.

force_escalation.rule: Any verified E3 or E4 evidence conflicting with the current integrator disposition forces escalation at all severities; verified E2 conflict forces escalation for HIGH/CRITICAL.

evidence_requirement_matrix.tuning_rule: Threshold changes require ProcessChangeImpactAssessment; simplification/health evidence may propose adjustment but cannot silently mutate defaults.

e3_e4_conflict.rule: A verified E3-vs-E4 conflict is a higher-order finding; neither class automatically wins.
e3_e4_conflict.effect: Freeze only affected dependent scope until conflict is resolved or explicitly bounded as UNKNOWN.

major_split.MAJOR_DELEGABLE: Material invariant/topology change or >10 semantic deltas with no authority/HSA/rights/constitutional semantic change. Eligible for delegated admission/integration; canonical promotion is automated only if an explicit current delegation envelope separately grants that authority.
major_split.MAJOR_PROTECTED: Any authority, HSA, rights, constitutional, protected-human-sovereignty or protected-promotion semantic change. Requires protected human decision.
major_split.shared_requirement: Both use the strongest review/composition profile.

classes.COSMETIC: No behavioral/routing/evidence/admission/authority effect; LIGHT track; no delta re-review.
classes.CLARIFYING: Meaning made more explicit without changing threshold/authority/outcome; re-review only deltas whose process dependency intersects the clarified rule.
classes.SUBSTANTIVE: Changes routing, thresholds, evidence semantics, admission, rollback, authority, privacy, HSA, protected boundaries or required artifacts; affected in-flight deltas require re-review or explicit grandfathering.

lineage_unknown.rule: Unknown lineage is not CONFIRMED_INDEPENDENT. Reviewers with unknown lineage are conservatively treated as correlated with other unknown-lineage reviewers for effective-family counting unless published evidence supports separation.
lineage_unknown.evidence_required_for_confirmed_independ: Provider/base-model lineage evidence sufficient to distinguish model ancestry/routing; corpus independence need not be claimed when unknowable.
lineage_unknown.publication: Publish lineage table entry, evidence source, confidence, last_verified_at and routing path.

rollback_window.attribution_pause_rule: If a qualifying incident is detected before window expiry, pause the remaining rollback-decision time while typed attribution is actively unresolved; resume after attribution resolution.
rollback_window.example: Incident detected on day 29 with one day remaining and attribution completing on day 45 still leaves one decision day after attribution.
rollback_window.candidate_execution_split: Automatic evidence may raise ROLLBACK_CANDIDATE; execution remains separately authorized.

rules: SectionUnit review, research, cross-examination and candidate preparation continue above the cap.
Otherwise-admissible semantic candidates above the cap are not added to the admitted set.
Successor composition uses admitted deltas only.
When promotion capacity returns, drain ACCEPTED_PENDING_CAPACITY oldest-first, but require fresh binding/reverification against current DesignEpoch/process before admission.

states.EXECUTABLE: Required checker/test/receipt exists for enforceable behavior.
states.DECLARATIVE: Machine enforcement is intended/possible but not yet implemented; tracked as known unenforced obligation.
states.NOT_ENFORCEABLE: Requirement is structurally normative/qualitative and no sound machine enforcement is claimed.

enforcement_status.aging_rule: A DECLARATIVE item reaching the aging threshold without justified extension raises SWARM_FIX; risk-specific policy may shorten the threshold.
enforcement_status.not_enforceable_rule: NOT_ENFORCEABLE requires rationale and must not generate repeated closure attempts unless enforcement feasibility changes.

budget_routing.unspent_reserve_rule: Reserve may be released to routine work late in the Asia/Kolkata day only when no unresolved HIGH/CRITICAL escalation queue exists.
budget_routing.expensive_call_rule: Any single OpenRouter escalation reserving >0.15 USD requires explicit human approval under the current $1/day authorization.
budget_routing.rule: These are logical pools under one hard $1/day ceiling; they do not authorize extra spend.

reviewer_scoring.rule: Challenger survival may contribute at most 0.10 of allocation score. External outcomes dominate reviewer allocation; diversity floors remain mandatory.

pipeline_change_control.rule: The canonical-update process and its routing/threshold/authority semantics are protected. It cannot self-amend through ordinary Builder authority.
pipeline_change_control.required_path: ProcessVersion bump + ProcessChangeImpactAssessment + applicable blind review/cross-exam/whole-source comparison + protected admission for protected semantics.

default_alerts.REJECTION_CONCENTRATION_SUSPECTED: at least 20 proposals in 30d AND one rejection reason > 80%

zero_delta_health.rule: Alerts trigger audit/diagnosis, not automatic threshold loosening.

promotion_boundary: Tracking-only v1.2 process refinement. It does not modify canonical v15.5, admit v15.6 deltas, expand authority or promote a successor.
